## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: A fixture session recorded under a deleted worktree path is associated with...

The system SHALL ensure that a fixture session recorded under a deleted worktree path is associated with this repo via the dead-path tier and the association record names the tier.

#### Scenario: A fixture session recorded under a deleted worktree path is associated with...

WHEN `add-worktree-and-remote-session-association` is implemented
THEN A fixture session recorded under a deleted worktree path is associated with this repo via the dead-path tier and the association record names the tier.

### Requirement: A fixture session from a sibling worktree is associated via the...

The system SHALL ensure that a fixture session from a sibling worktree is associated via the worktree-list tier without the best-effort flag.

#### Scenario: A fixture session from a sibling worktree is associated via the...

WHEN `add-worktree-and-remote-session-association` is implemented
THEN A fixture session from a sibling worktree is associated via the worktree-list tier without the best-effort flag.

### Requirement: With the best-effort tier disabled, sessions matching only by repo name are...

The system SHALL ensure that with the best-effort tier disabled, sessions matching only by repo name are excluded (asserted by test).

#### Scenario: With the best-effort tier disabled, sessions matching only by repo name are...

WHEN `add-worktree-and-remote-session-association` is implemented
THEN With the best-effort tier disabled, sessions matching only by repo name are excluded (asserted by test).
